text: Physics in Performance 12 October 2018 Research Plan for the 3rd Year Module PHY3003M Physics Project My project, Physics in Performance, ties together both physics and drama to create a useful resource and way of conveying physics. During the first semester, I will research a topic and during the second semester, I will create a video which explains some of the principles from my research during first semester. This may include an experiment to show the key elements and participation from the surrounding community. After researching previous people who have worked within these two fields, I have found a couple of people who have produced work similar to the way I intend my final piece to look. I found a YouTube channel called ‘Veritasium’ which contains an extensive series of videos produced by Derek Muller about physics of the world. I have also found a lady, namely Dr Jessamyn Fairfield who incorporates comedy and physics in one in order to engage her audience as well as teaching different disciplines of physics. This interests me as stand-up comedy is a passion of mine and finding a way to incorporate physics into a comedy sketch would be a potential idea for my performance. I intend to get in contact with both these individuals to determine whether they have any ideas to help with my project. I have decided to do this project with the aim of using it to further my career as an actor. I feel that by combining both performance and physics for my final year project will open doors to either discipline once I have finished. To continue with my project, I will require a topic in which to create the video about. For this I will require a set of books related to physics containing subjects that will be able to be turned into a performance. I have found three books so far that I feel will offer plenty of options for my topic. These include: The Physics of Everyday Things by James Kakalois, The Physics of Sound by David Stork and Richard Berg, and Classical Mechanics by T.W.B. Kibble. From these books I will aim to find the topic in which I will research and then, during second semester, create my performance piece around. However, I may require further literature to find my topic and once I’ve found my topic, to help with research into the chosen topic. The work place in which I will be doing most of my project with be in the University of Lincoln, Isaac Newton building. Once my topic has been chosen I will have a clearer idea as to where will be beneficial to be situated in order to complete my project. For equipment and facilities, I will require to complete my project, I will have to determine the topic prior to this as this will inform me of a potential experiment and therefore what equipment I require. The cost of my project is unclear as of yet as I haven’t got a list of required items. Once my topic is decided and a list has been complied of potential items that I require, this will be discussed in a meeting with my supervisor, Fabien, and an agreement of the overall cost will be arranged.
